title: Kona Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Vemar Kona Matte Black is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, bridging highway aero efficiency with rugged off-road ventilation. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1396g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Dual-sport with removable peak, Pinlock visor, and anti-fog system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Vemar Kona Matte Black is an adventure/dual-sport helmet. Specific technical data points such as ASIN, EAN, MPN, homologation standards (e.g., ECE 22.06), and specific internal dimensions like speaker pocket depth are not publicly documented in standard product listings for this model.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Vemar Kona Matte Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Vemar's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Kona Matte Black brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Vemar Kona Matte Black represents Vemar's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Vemar Kona Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
